title: ggmultiglyph: Multivariate Data Visualization using Glyphs
description: Provides 'ggplot2' geoms for visualizing multivariate data using glyphs. The package implements several established glyph designs described in the information visualization literature, including the review by Borgo et al. (2013) <https://doi.org/10.2312/conf/EG2013/stars/039-063>.
